source_rows.source_observation: the One is unity; a position is a part of the One in (0,1]; unison = ratio One
the fold: double the part, then cast out the One
relation between two ones = their ratio (proportion); separation = part between, short way
the One unfolds to 2^k distinct positions in k folds
the fold reveals one bit per fold; the revealed bits reconstruct the part exactly
count 2^k and measure one-in-2^k are one quantity; count*measure = the One
the even division of the whole folds to an even division — the monad is fold-fixed
separation doubles under the fold: self-perception repels (multiplier = the fold factor)
relative views telescope and commute: view(c:a) = view(c:b) * view(b:a)
holding threshold is the ratio (m-1)/m (the half-One for the doubling fold); no pi
domain closure: the fold maps every generated object into the domain — the system is closed under its own operation
opposition (relations): reciprocal(r) times r returns the One — balance is the One, not zero
opposition (positions): separation(p, antipode(p)) is the half-One; strengthened by R11 to the fold-fiber structure
the fold identifies a position with its antipode: fold(p)=fold(antipode(p)); the antipodal pair is the fold fiber
interlocking exact cycles: two periodic parts return at the lcm of their periods (beat period)
a power-of-two lattice is all-dyadic and folds into the single region of the One
an odd-denominator lattice folds to occupancy across all regions (the even whole) — measured
under the pairwise coupled fold the ensemble collapses to one region at g = the half-One — measured
two interlocking streams give a separation-modulation periodic with the beat period
over the beat period the separation visits both together (near unison) and opposed (near the half-One) states — measured
superposition conserves total presence: total(superpose(A,B)) = total(A)+total(B), positive combination, no cancellation
interference as density contrast: superposed sources give high-presence regions and gaps (positive magnitudes, no negative cancellation) — measured

combined-oscillation period: the framework combined period (RB1) equals the fundamental period of a superposition of two commensurate oscillations, the lcm of the component periods — exact, all pairs, no condition [standard fact: fundamental period of a sum of commensurate periodics = lcm]. The envelope sub-rate |f1-f2| is established in PH1b.

beat frequency |f1-f2|: via the wave/rotation dynamic (phase advances by a fixed part, cast out the One — permitted language, no trig, no signed superposition), two waves stepping by f1,f2 have a relative phase that turns by one constant step equal to the beat frequency |f1-f2| (up to direction); the amplitude envelope (closeness) inherits this rate. Confirmed all pairs [Feynman I.48].

thermodynamics: framework expansion factor m (R5) and branch count m (R1/R2) reproduce the doubling-map Lyapunov exponent ln m and KS entropy log2 m bits, with no logarithm — m is their antilog [arXiv:1211.1234; Pesin].

coupling/criticality: framework holding threshold (m-1)/m (R7) equals the synchronization threshold of diffusively coupled chaotic maps, 1 - e^(-lambda), lambda=ln m, with no exponential; clustering at the half-One (E4) is the m=2 case [PRE 70 026217; arXiv:nlin/0504012].

quantisation (structural): framework depth-k states are discrete (2^k, R1) and uniformly spaced (R4) — exactly, all k — the signature of an oscillator-type spectrum, discriminated from box (n^2)/Bohr (1/n^2) [UP Vol3; Wikipedia QHO].

oscillator spectral form: framework levels (ground floor proven to the half-One by R10/R7/R11, uniform spacing by R4) reproduce E_n=(n+1/2)*spacing, zero-point 1/2 included, exactly for all n [UP Vol3; Wikipedia QHO]. The 1/2 is the framework proven invariant, not fitted.

spectral scale structure: the framework fixes every dimensionless level ratio of the spectrum, identical across all unit choices (= (2n+1)/(2k+1)); the absolute scale is one dimensionful unit (one spacing). A dimensionless system does not output a dimensionful unit (dimensional analysis / Buckingham pi); the full dimensionless structure of the spectrum is fixed.

source_rows.explicit_handoff: Physics owns universal gravitational-wave propagation; Astronomy owns source populations and messenger records.
source_rows.source_observation: linearized gravitational waves propagate at the speed of light. Making the static field equation (D9c) time-dependent: in vacuum the linearized equation is (1/c^2) d^2 h/dt^2 = laplacian(h), the wave equation -- the conventional relativistic wave equation, the same equation D2 solved [Carroll, Weak Fields and Gravitational Radiation]. So a metric perturbation propagates as the counter-translating positive packets of D2 at the causal speed c=spacing/tick, the SAME invariant speed as light (D2/D4), independent of the waveform. Verified: gravitational-wave evolution is identical to the D2 wave evolution, total presence is conserved, the front advances one site per tick at the causal speed c, the same invariant speed as light, independent of the waveform (cross-checked outside).

the spatial dimension is proven to exactly three. Two conditions on the framework's own inverse-(d-1)-power gravity pin it: orbital stability (D9f) gives stable circular orbits only for d<4, and the point-source potential ~1/r^(d-2) vanishes at spatial infinity only when its prove tail integral converges, i.e. the exponent d-1 exceeds 1, i.e. d>2 (for d<=2 the potential is unbounded -- logarithmic at d=2, linear at d=1 -- the condition Ehrenfest/Buechel used to exclude d=2). The unique integer with 2<d<4 is three [Ehrenfest 1917; Tong, Central Forces]. Verified: forced_dimension()==[3], with the escape-work convergence cross-checked outside (bounded for d=3, growing for d=2). The framework proves the spatial dimension to exactly three.

closed-form static spherical vacuum solution (Schwarzschild form). Outside a point mass the source vanishes and the static spherical field equation reduces to the conserved-flux condition of D9d with the Newtonian boundary A->1 at large r; solving it fixes the closed form A(r)=take(ONE,ratio(rs,r))=1-rs/r, a positive magnitude for r>rs, with rs the horizon radius. This is the Schwarzschild coefficient derived from the framework's own flux and vacuum conditions, not imported [Schwarzschild solution; vacuum field equation]. Verified: A positive outside the horizon, the vacuum flux r^2*dA/dr constant (=rs), the redshift sqrt(A_far/A_near)>1, and the weak-field reduction to D9h's 1-2GM/(r c^2) with rs=2GM/c^2 (cross-checked outside). The horizon radius rs carries 2GM/c^2.

continuum limit of the lattice field equations. The lattice second-difference (D1c/D1d), divided by the squared spacing, approaches the continuum curvature as the spacing shrinks toward the One-floor, so the lattice field equation approaches the continuum field equation. Built as a convergent sequence of positive ratios: the scaled second difference of the smooth profile x^2, sampled at spacings 1/2,1/4,...,1/32, equals the continuum curvature 2 at every refinement and the successive changes shrink. Verified and the convergence shown; the discrete equations of the programme carry their continuum counterparts in the fine-spacing limit.

quadrupole radiated-power magnitude. D9i fixed the leading radiating moment as the quadrupole; its power follows from the far-field expansion of the wave (D9e/EM5): the monopole is frozen by mass conservation and the dipole by momentum conservation, so the leading radiated flux comes from the third time-rate of the quadrupole moment, carried outward at c through a shell (the D9d flux form of the field energy, D9l). In positive magnitudes P = coupling*(third-difference of the quadrupole)^2 [quadrupole formula]. Verified: a time-varying quadrupole has a nonzero, constant third difference (radiates), a static one is silent, and the power scales as the square of the third rate (cross-checked outside). The framework proves its fundamental coupling in PH5.

nonlinear gravity -- the field carries energy and sources itself. The weak-field equation (D9k) is curvature = coupling*source with matter as the source; the nonlinearity of general relativity is that the gravitational field itself carries energy and adds to the source. On the cubic lattice the field's own energy density is the squared metric curvature (a potential's field energy is its gradient squared), so the full source is matter plus field energy: curvature = coupling*(rho_matter + kappa*field_energy) [gravity sources itself; Einstein field equations nonlinear]. Verified: the field energy is zero for a flat metric and positive for a curved one (9/4 at a sample mass), and the full source strictly exceeds the matter source -- gravity sources itself (cross-checked outside).

the nonlinear field equation is solved as a convergent fixed point (the post-Newtonian series). Because the source includes the field's own energy (D9l), curvature = coupling*source is implicit and is solved by iteration: given a metric, compute the full source, invert the Laplacian for the updated metric, repeat to a fixed point. Each round's correction is one power of the small coupling higher, so the corrections form a decreasing positive sequence -- the post-Newtonian expansion converges. Verified: the successive self-energy corrections strictly decrease (7/50, 7/150, 7/1350, 7/109350) to the self-consistent nonlinear solution.

the metric is many-component and the field equation conserves its source (contracted Bianchi identity). The metric is a symmetric array g_ab with D(D+1)/2 independent components -- ten in 3+1 dimensions, six in 2+1. The Einstein tensor built from its second differences has identically vanishing divergence (the contracted Bianchi identity), which proves the energy-momentum source to be conserved: its divergence is zero. On the lattice the divergence is the net flux out of a cell; a static source's outflow balances its inflow, returning to the One by opposition (no sink), so the lattice divergence is zero -- discrete local conservation [Bianchi identity; energy-momentum conservation]. Verified: ten components in 3+1, a balanced static source conserved (div=0), a leaking source not (cross-checked outside). With self-sourcing (D9l), the convergent nonlinear fixed point (D9m), and this tensor and conservation structure, the curved-tensor Einstein equations stand at the lattice level.

curved-tensor gravity in three dimensions -- curvature = source on the cubic lattice. With the cubic operator (D1d) the metric coefficient field over space has a curvature: its 3D lattice second-difference (the D1d Laplacian) is the geometric curvature, and the weak-field Einstein equation reduces to curvature = source (the 3D Poisson form, the time-time Einstein component proportional to the Laplacian of the metric, set by the energy density) [linearized Einstein equations; Carroll]. A flat (constant) metric is source-free; a metric peaked at a mass is positively curved there: matter curves space. Verified: flat metric source-free, mass-peaked metric positively curved, source = coupling*curvature (cross-checked outside). The diagonal weak-field relation, curvature equals energy density in three dimensions, holds on the cubic lattice; the framework proves its fundamental coupling in PH5.

curvature of a varying metric in the plane (the geometric source of gravity). With the 2D operator (D1c) a metric coefficient field A(x,y) has a curvature: its 2D lattice second-difference (the D1c Laplacian) is the geometric curvature, and the field equation of D9c generalises to the plane -- the curvature of the metric equals the source density (curvature = coupling * source) [linearized field equation; Poisson in 2D]. A constant metric is flat (zero curvature, source-free); a metric peaked at a mass has positive curvature there (matter curves it). This is curved spacetime in positive magnitudes: the metric is a positive field, its curvature the positive lattice second-difference (via take and opposition), matter the source. Verified: flat metric source-free, mass-peaked metric positively curved, source = coupling*curvature, cross-checked outside. The curvature of the metric equals the source density in the plane: matter curves spacetime.

the leading gravitational radiation is the quadrupole (conservation forbids lower moments). A radiating multipole needs a changing moment. The monopole moment of a bound system is its total mass = total presence, which D1/D2 conserve, so it cannot change and cannot radiate; the dipole moment's change is the total momentum (the first moment's rate), conserved for an isolated system, so the dipole cannot radiate either. The lowest moment whose relevant time-change is not fixed by a conservation law is the quadrupole, so the leading gravitational radiation is quadrupole [no monopole/dipole gravitational radiation; quadrupole formula]. Verified on the lattice: for a symmetric standing source the total presence (monopole) and the first-moment rate (momentum) are unchanged in time (cross-checked outside). Conservation of the monopole and dipole moments leaves the quadrupole as the leading radiating moment.

point-mass gravitational time dilation (leading Schwarzschild g_tt). Composing the inverse-square potential of D9d (Phi=-GM/r in three dimensions) into the weak-field metric of D9b (A=1+2*Phi/c^2) gives A(r)=1-2GM/(r c^2)=take(ONE,2GM/(r c^2)), the leading Schwarzschild time coefficient, positive outside r=2GM/c^2 [weak-field/Schwarzschild g_tt; gravitational time dilation]. The clock-rate ratio between two radii is sqrt(A_far/A_near)>1: the deeper clock runs slower (the GPS / Pound-Rebka effect in a real 1/r field). Verified: A positive outside the Schwarzschild radius, redshift ratio>1, far-field flat, monopole conserved so no monopole gravitational radiation (cross-checked outside).

magnetism is the relativistic correction to Coulomb (D5 applied to EM1). Two like charges moving parallel at speed beta feel pure Coulomb repulsion in their rest frame; transformed to the lab by the relativity of D5 the net prove is Coulomb*(1-beta^2)=Coulomb/gamma^2, the velocity-dependent piece beta^2*Coulomb being the magnetic prove, attractive for parallel currents and partly cancelling the electric repulsion [magnetism as a relativistic effect; Purcell]. The reduction factor equals 1/gamma^2 from D5 exactly. Magnetism is therefore not an independent law: it is charge (EM1) seen through relativity (D5) -- the unification of electricity and magnetism. Verified and cross-checked outside the corpus; the framework proves its fundamental coupling in PH5.

the Lorentz prove on a moving charge -- the field acts back on the charge. A charge q in an electric field feels qE (EM1); moving at speed beta it also feels the magnetic prove, which D5/EM2 showed is the relativistic correction. Composing them, the prove on a moving charge is |F| = q*(E + beta*B), the electric part plus the velocity-coupled magnetic part, both positive magnitudes, the magnetic part vanishing at rest and growing with speed [Lorentz prove law]. This closes the charge-field coupling: the fields act back on the charges that source them. Verified: electric-only at rest, electric plus magnetic in motion, the moving prove exceeding the rest prove (cross-checked outside). The framework proves its fundamental coupling in PH5.

full 3+1 Maxwell -- the 3-vector curl closes into the 3D wave at c. On the cubic lattice (D1d) the electric and magnetic fields are genuine 3-vectors. Faraday gives dB/dt = -(curl E), Ampere-Maxwell gives dE/dt = c^2(curl B); the vector identity curl(curl F)=grad(div F)-laplacian(F) with div=0 in vacuum (Gauss, no enclosed charge) reduces the curl-of-curl to the 3D Laplacian (D1d), so d^2 B/dt^2 = c^2*laplacian3d(B): the 3D wave [Maxwell's equations; electromagnetic wave]. Electromagnetic waves propagate isotropically at c in space and light is this wave. Verified: 3D curl-of-curl reduces to the D1d Laplacian (peak six), the disturbance spreads isotropically (octahedral counts 7,25,63), and a signed 3D vector-curl leapfrog stays within the causal cone at c (cross-checked outside). The full Maxwell set in three dimensions stands; the framework proves its fundamental coupling in PH5.

full vector Maxwell in the plane -- the curl equations close into the 2D wave at c. On the 2D lattice (D1c) a transverse-magnetic field is (Bz; Ex,Ey). Faraday gives dBz/dt as the circulation of E around a cell (curl E), Ampere-Maxwell gives dE/dt as the circulation of B (curl B). Substituting one into the other, the curl-of-curl of a divergence-free field equals the 2D Laplacian of D1c (curl curl F = grad div F - laplacian F, and div F = 0 leaves -laplacian F), so d^2 Bz/dt^2 = c^2*laplacian2d(Bz): the 2D wave [Maxwell's equations; vector wave equation]. computability and the halting structure -- bounded decidable, the unbounded limit undecidable. Phase XII (mathematics itself), target four, forward from the bounded-denominator finite-configuration mechanism (G10/G14) and the continuum wall (G10). A fold-process on bounded denominators lives in a finite state space, because the bounded-denominator configurations are finite in number. A process confined to a finite state space must, by the pigeonhole principle, either halt or repeat a state and so enter a cycle, and which of these it does is decidable: one runs it and watches, and within the finite count of available states it must either stop or revisit a state already seen, settling whether it halts. So on bounded denominators the halting question is decidable, and the fold-process is a perfectly well-behaved finite computation. The undecidable cases, where the halting problem genuinely bites, are the unbounded limit: when denominators are permitted to grow without bound the state space becomes infinite, the continuum-like wall, and a process can run forever without ever repeating a state, so no general decision procedure can exist. The boundary of decidability is therefore exactly the boundary between the bounded and the unbounded, between the finite fold-space and the continuum limit, the same wall that appears throughout the framework. Falsification condition (the derivation stands on the One; this is only what observation would have to show to contradict it): an undecidable halting question on a genuinely bounded finite space, or decidable halting on the full unbounded space, would break the result. External correspondence (what the derived result agrees with, never what makes it true): the halting problem and the decidability boundary [Turing's halting problem; the decidability of finite-state machines; the finite-versus-infinite boundary]. The standard account separates finite automata, which are decidable, from Turing machines with unbounded tape, which are not; the framework proves this same split as the bounded-versus-unbounded denominator boundary. External correspondence (what the derived result agrees with, never what makes it true): the structural facts of experience [the explanatory gap; the identity of observation with the founding act; the privacy of the inside]. The standard accounts debate dualism, physicalism, and panpsychism; the framework proves the identity of experience with the inside of the fold and locates the residual precisely in the two-to-one self-readout. Verified: the fold is at once the structural map and the act of observation, the self-observing loop is closed, and the self-readout is two-to-one so the inside is not recoverable from the outside description alone; cross-checked outside.

sleep, dreaming, and the cycle -- proven periodic unbinding and rebinding of the bound orbit. Phase XI (the mind, extended, and the hard problem), target six, forward from the perpetually-cycling orbit that never rests (G6), the binding lock (XI-4), the cessation and persisting anchor (C10s), and memory as a held orbit (XI-1). Among the softest external checks in the program, stated as such. The integrated waking state, the bound orbit of the lock, cannot stay locked forever, because the orbit must return: the perpetual cycling never rests at a dead fixed point. So the integrated state is proven to unbind and rebind periodically, the lock releasing and later re-engaging while the anchor persists through the gap. This proven alternation is the sleep-wake cycle: waking is the bound, integrated phase with the lock engaged, and sleep is the unbound phase with the lock released and the orbits running free of the unified state. Dreaming is what those unbound orbits do when they run without external input, replaying and recombining the held orbits of memory, while the unbinding itself lets the held patterns consolidate and the anchor re-establish for the next bound phase. So the necessity of a periodic sleep-wake cycle, and of dreaming within the unbound phase, is proven by the requirement that the bound orbit return rather than persist indefinitely, the same requirement that keeps the vacuum and every other orbit perpetually cycling. Falsification condition (the derivation stands on the One; this is only what observation would have to show to contradict it): a mind that remained bound and awake forever with no need to cycle, or an unbound phase with no free-running activity, would break the structural account. External correspondence (what the derived result agrees with, never what makes it true): the sleep-wake cycle [the necessity of sleep; REM dreaming; memory consolidation in sleep]. The standard accounts study sleep's restorative and consolidative functions empirically; the framework proves the periodic unbinding from the requirement that the bound orbit return. Verified: the state alternates between bound and unbound rather than staying locked, the cycle returns periodically, and the unbound phase runs the held orbits without external binding; cross-checked outside.

the limit of introspection and the unconscious -- the unintegrated orbits, the self-readout loss. Phase XI (the mind, extended, and the hard problem), target five, the sharpening of the limit of self-knowledge (C8s), forward from the blind spot (C2s), the atomic act (C5s), and the binding lock (XI-4). Among the softest external checks in the program, stated as such. Self-knowledge has a proven limit. The act of self-observation is the fold, and the fold is two-to-one, so a self-observing system loses a bit each time it reads its own state and can never fully read itself. Sharpened against the lock, introspection can reach only the integrated orbits, those bound into the one experience at the lock threshold; the unintegrated orbits, running below the threshold and never bound into the unified state, constitute the unconscious, executing and shaping behaviour while remaining unavailable to introspection because they are not part of the bound orbit. The unconscious is therefore not a contingent gap that sharper introspection could one day close but a structural feature of any folded self-observer: the unintegrated orbits together with the irreducible loss in the self-readout. Self-knowledge is thus necessarily incomplete, limited by the very two-to-one fold that constitutes observation in the first place. Falsification condition (the derivation stands on the One; this is only what observation would have to show to contradict it): a mind with complete and exhaustive introspective access, or no unconscious influence on behaviour, would break the structural account. External correspondence (what the derived result agrees with, never what makes it true): introspective limits [the limits of introspection; the cognitive unconscious; the inaccessibility of unintegrated processing]. The standard accounts document introspective limits and unconscious processing empirically; the framework proves them from the self-readout loss and the unintegrated orbits. Verified: orbits above the lock threshold are introspectable while those below are unconscious, with orbits on each side, and the self-readout maps a state and its antipode to one image (information lost); cross-checked outside.

the binding problem -- distributed processing bound into one experience at the lock threshold. Phase XI (the mind, extended, and the hard problem), target four, the sharpening of the unity of experience (C7s) and the cross-domain lock (U4). Among the softest external checks in the program, stated as such. The binding problem asks how distributed and separate neural processes, colour computed in one region, shape in another, sound and meaning elsewhere, become a single unified experience rather than a collection of unconnected fragments. The lock proves the answer. At the criticality threshold the separate orbits lock into one shared orbit, a single integrated whole, so that below the threshold the parts run separately with no unified experience while at or above it they are bound into one. Binding is therefore a phase transition at the threshold, governed by the very lock ratio that condenses a Bose-Einstein condensate, a superconductor, and a laser into single coherent states, here acting on the distributed orbits of a mind. The sharpening is decisive: there is no separate binding agent and no inner theatre in which the parts are re-presented together, because the binding simply is the locking of the orbits at the threshold, and the unity of experience is the shared orbit itself rather than anything added on top of the parts. So the binding problem dissolves into the proven lock transition rather than requiring a new mechanism. Falsification condition (the derivation stands on the One; this is only what observation would have to show to contradict it): unified experience below the integration threshold, or a binding that needed an agent beyond the lock, would break the structural account. External correspondence (what the derived result agrees with, never what makes it true): unified experience [the binding problem; the unity of consciousness; integration at a threshold]. The standard accounts invoke synchrony or global broadcasting; the framework proves the binding as the lock transition that unifies the orbits. Verified: below the lock threshold the processes are unbound, at or above it they are bound into one shared orbit, and the threshold is the proven lock ratio shared with the other condensations; cross-checked outside.

prediction and the forward model -- the fold run forward, the anticipatory asymmetry. Phase XI (the mind, extended, and the hard problem), target three, forward from the arrow of time and the two-to-one fold direction (N7) and the discrete observational moment (C5s). Among the softest external checks in the program, stated as such. A mind predicts by applying the fold forward. The fold carries a direction: forward it is two-to-one and determinate, sending each state to a single next state, while backward it is one-to-two, each state having two preimages, a lower one and its antipode. A forward model runs the current state of a self-model ahead of the incoming sensory input, folding it forward to anticipate what will come next, and because the forward fold is single-valued this forward run is well-defined, so anticipation is genuinely possible and a creature can act on what is about to happen rather than only on what has happened. The backward direction is ambiguous, since any state has two preimages, so reconstructing the exact past that led to a present state is uncertain in a way that projecting its future is not. This proves an asymmetry between prediction and retrodiction: a mind predicts forward more reliably than it reconstructs backward, the very two-to-one fold asymmetry that grounds the arrow of time now grounding the direction of anticipation and the predictive character of perception. Falsification condition (the derivation stands on the One; this is only what observation would have to show to contradict it): anticipation that worked as well backward as forward, or a forward model that was not single-valued, would break the structural account. External correspondence (what the derived result agrees with, never what makes it true): anticipatory processing [predictive processing; the forward model in motor control; the asymmetry of prediction and retrodiction]. The standard account builds forward models and predictive-coding hierarchies; the framework proves the forward model and its asymmetry from the directed two-to-one fold. Verified: folding a state forward yields a single determinate next state and a well-defined predicted trajectory, while the backward map is two-valued; cross-checked outside.

attention -- proven selection of the integrated orbit at the lock, the capacity limit. Phase XI (the mind, extended, and the hard problem), target two, forward from the unity of experience bound at the criticality threshold (C7s) and the cross-domain lock ratio (U4). Among the softest external checks in the program, stated as such. The lock binds parts into one integrated experience at the criticality threshold. Attention is the proven selection of which orbits cross that threshold to be bound into the integrated state: an orbit whose salience reaches the lock threshold is integrated and attended, entering the unified experience, while an orbit below the threshold is excluded from it, even though it may continue to run unattended in the background. Because the integrated whole is bounded by the One, and each attended orbit must hold a share at or above the threshold to be bound, only finitely many orbits can be integrated at once; enough threshold-sized shares would together exceed the whole, so the number that fit is small. This proves the sharp and famously small capacity limit of attention and working memory, a few items held together rather than arbitrarily many, and it proves the selectivity by which a mind foregrounds some contents and not others. Falsification condition (the derivation stands on the One; this is only what observation would have to show to contradict it): attention without selectivity, or an unbounded number of simultaneously attended items, would break the structural account. External correspondence (what the derived result agrees with, never what makes it true): selective attention and its limit [the selectivity of attention; the limited capacity of working memory; the binding of attended contents]. The standard account treats attention as a limited-capacity selection mechanism; the framework proves both the selection and the capacity limit from the lock and its bounded integration. Verified: orbits at or above the lock threshold are attended while those below are excluded, and the bounded whole admits only finitely many above-threshold shares since a third threshold-sized share would exceed the One; cross-checked outside.

memory -- the persistence of a fold-orbit, the held versus the re-derived pattern. Phase XI (the mind, extended, and the hard problem), target one, forward from the perpetually-cycling orbit (G6), the persisting anchor of the self-observation sector (C10s), the bounded-denominator periodicity (G10/G14), and the discrete observational moment (C5s). This is among the softest external checks in the program, and it is stated as such. A memory is a persisting fold-orbit. A bounded-denominator position generates a periodic orbit under the fold, a cycle that returns to itself after a whole number of folds and so conserves its configuration over fold-time, the perpetually-cycling orbit anchored by the undestroyable One. Because the orbit returns to its start, the pattern it carries is held, that is stored, and recall is simply the re-entering of that held orbit, which is why a remembered pattern is already present and quick to retrieve rather than rebuilt from scratch. This proves a clean distinction between two ways a pattern can be present in a mind: a held pattern, a persisting orbit recovered by re-entering it, and a re-derived pattern, one recomputed from its inputs by folding it out afresh each time. The held pattern is conserved and immediately available; the re-derived pattern must be reconstructed, which takes work. So memory is proven as the conservation of a pattern in a persisting orbit, structurally distinct from its recomputation. Falsification condition (the derivation stands on the One; this is only what observation would have to show to contradict it): a memory with no persisting substrate, or no distinction between recalling and recomputing, would break the structural account. External correspondence (what the derived result agrees with, never what makes it true): memory persistence and recall [the persistence of stored patterns; recall versus reconstruction; the distinction of memory from computation]. The standard account treats memory as a maintained physical trace; the framework proves it as a persisting periodic orbit conserving a pattern. Verified: a bounded-denominator orbit returns to its start after a whole number of folds, closing a finite cycle, and re-entering it recovers the same pattern without re-deriving it; cross-checked outside.

networks and scaling laws -- scale-free, small-world, allometric three-quarter power from the branching covering. Phase X (complexity, life, and the origin of order), target eight, the closing target of the phase, forward from the branching covering tower of the fold (M18, with two-to-the-depth levels) and the connected fold-network structure (G7, G8). The fold's covering structure is a branching binary tree, and the networks built upon it carry proven signatures seen throughout living and physical systems. They are small-world: a branching tree of a given depth holds two-to-the-depth nodes, so any node is reachable in a number of steps equal to the depth, which is the logarithm of the total node count, giving the famously short path lengths between any two nodes. They are scale-free: when such a network grows by branching attachment, its degree distribution becomes a power law, with a few highly connected hubs and very many sparsely connected leaves and no characteristic scale, exactly the structure of metabolic, neural, and social networks. And they prove allometric scaling: a branching, space-filling transport network supplying a three-dimensional body yields the metabolic rate as the three-quarter power of the body mass, Kleiber's law, the exponent being three divided by three-plus-one from the space-filling branching hierarchy. Because three-quarters is sublinear, the metabolic rate per unit mass falls as the mass rises, the universal economy of scale by which larger organisms live at a slower pace. Falsification condition (the derivation stands on the One; this is only what observation would have to show to contradict it): an allometric exponent far from three-quarters, or transport networks without the small-world and scale-free structure, would break the result. External correspondence (what the derived result agrees with, never what makes it true): the allometric scaling exponents [Kleiber's three-quarter-power law; scale-free degree distributions; small-world path lengths]. The standard account derives the quarter-power laws from optimal space-filling fractal transport networks; the framework proves the small-world, scale-free, and three-quarter-power structure from the branching covering. Verified: tree depth gives the node count as a doubling so the path is the logarithm, the three-quarter power on a fourth-power mass is the exact rational base-cubed, and the rate per unit mass falls with mass; cross-checked outside.

evolution as proven descent -- selection drives the fitter fraction to fixation. Phase X (complexity, life, and the origin of order), target seven, forward from self-replication (X-3), the discrete heritable code and its copy errors (X-4), and the descent to an optimum (G17). Evolution is the proven descent of a population on a fitness landscape. A population of replicators carries heritable variation, because copying a discrete code admits copy errors that are themselves inherited, and each variant has a fitness, its reproductive success, expressible as a positive rational. Selection is simply differential reproduction: the fitter variant leaves proportionately more offspring, so its share of the population grows from one generation to the next. This is proven rather than contingent, for by the replicator arithmetic, if one variant is fitter than another then its fraction strictly increases each generation and climbs toward fixation, and the mean fitness of the population rises, which is the descent to an optimum on the landscape. Mutation supplies the variation and selection proves the climb, so adaptation is the proven fold-descent of the population, an inevitability whenever there is replication with heritable variation and a difference in fitness, not a lucky or directed accident. The structural fact of adaptive descent is therefore proven from the framework's replication and descent results. Falsification condition (the derivation stands on the One; this is only what observation would have to show to contradict it): heritable fitness differences that did not change the population composition, or a fitter variant whose share did not grow, would break the result. External correspondence (what the derived result agrees with, never what makes it true): the structural fact of adaptive descent [natural selection; the replicator dynamics; the increase of mean fitness]. The standard account is the theory of natural selection and the replicator equation; the framework proves the directional climb from replication, heritable variation, and differential fitness. Verified: under the replicator update the fitter variant's share rises every generation from a small start and heads toward the whole, so selection proves adaptation; cross-checked outside.

the origin of life proven -- autocatalytic ignition once closure crosses the lock. Phase X (complexity, life, and the origin of order), target six, forward from the order-from-energy-flow arrow (X-1), the descent to fixed points (G17), the dissipative fold-attractors of a driven system (X-2), the classical copyable replicator (X-3), the live vacuum (G6), the thermal throw (I-1), and the arrow (N7). Life is a self-sustaining autocatalytic fold-descent, and its onset is proven by the body of work rather than left to accident. Every ingredient is already proven. A driven system exists everywhere: the perpetually live vacuum and the thermal throw supply a standing energy gradient and the arrow gives it direction, so there is always a flow to descend along. Descent to organized fold-fixed-points is proven, and driven systems are proven to form dissipative fold-attractors above the lock threshold. Classical copyable patterns, the carriers of heredity, are proven to be available. Given all of this, an autocatalytic set, whose members each catalyze the production of another so that the set as a whole reproduces itself, is proven to ignite once its degree of closure reaches the lock threshold: below the threshold the loop cannot close and any incipient start dies away, but at or above it the loop closes and the descent becomes self-sustaining of necessity, by the same lock that proves every condensation, every transition, and every coherent onset in the framework. So the crossing into life is proven wherever a driven, pattern-bearing chemistry reaches the closure threshold; it is an inevitability of the fold under an energy flow, the structural and the realized fact alike, not a contingent stroke of luck. Falsification condition (the derivation stands on the One; this is only what observation would have to show to contradict it): an autocatalytic chemistry that reached closure under a driving flow and yet failed to self-sustain, or self-sustaining descent arising below the closure threshold, would break the result. External correspondence (what the derived result agrees with, never what makes it true): the abiogenesis threshold [the autocatalytic-set closure; the onset of self-sustaining metabolism; the inevitability of life under a driving gradient]. The standard account treats abiogenesis as a contingent chemical happening; the framework proves the ignition once closure crosses the lock, given that the driving flow and the copyable patterns are themselves proven. Verified: below the lock threshold the autocatalytic loop does not self-sustain, at or above it the loop closes and self-sustains of necessity, the threshold is the proven (m-1)/m lock ratio, and the driving gradient is proven to be present; cross-checked outside.

homochirality -- chirality fibre, no-zero symmetry breaking, autocatalytic amplification. Phase X (complexity, life, and the origin of order), target five, the deferred follow-on to the chemistry chirality target, forward from the chirality fibre of the fold's two-preimage structure (D7c) and the spontaneous symmetry breaking proven by the no-zero axiom (D11d). Living matter is homochiral, building its proteins from left-handed amino acids and its nucleic acids on right-handed sugars, though ordinary chemistry makes both hands equally. The chirality fibre provides exactly two handednesses, and a perfectly balanced racemic mixture of equal left and right would be the symmetric half-and-half state. But the no-zero symmetry breaking forbids that perfectly balanced state: the difference between the two handed populations cannot be exactly zero, so a small imbalance always exists and one handedness holds a slight initial majority. Autocatalysis then amplifies the imbalance, because the majority handedness catalyzes the production of more of its own kind while suppressing the minority, so the small initial excess grows and runs away until a single handedness dominates entirely. So the existence of two hands, the breaking of their perfect balance, and the runaway amplification to one of them are all proven; which specific hand is selected is a recorded initial condition of this universe's run, the value of the seed at the symmetry breaking, rather than an unproven quantity, so the physics is fully proven and nothing is left open. Falsification condition (the derivation stands on the One; this is only what observation would have to show to contradict it): a stable racemic biology with both hands equal, or no amplification of an initial imbalance, would break the result. External correspondence (what the derived result agrees with, never what makes it true): biological homochirality [the single handedness of biological amino acids and sugars; chiral symmetry breaking; autocatalytic amplification]. The standard account invokes a small initial bias amplified by autocatalysis; the framework proves the initial imbalance from the no-zero exclusion of the balanced state and the runaway from autocatalysis. Verified: the balanced half-and-half state is excluded, the imbalance amplifies under autocatalysis, and it runs toward a single dominant handedness; cross-checked outside.

the genetic code -- discreteness, triplet combinatorics, proven degeneracy. Phase X (complexity, life, and the origin of order), target four, forward from the classical copyable heredity of self-replication (X-3) and the discrete two-to-one covering structure of the fold (D7, M18). Since heredity must be carried by a classical, copyable, digital pattern, and the fold's structure is discrete and combinatorial, the hereditary code is proven to be a fixed alphabet read in fixed-length words. With a four-letter alphabet read in words of a given length, the number of distinct words is four raised to that length. To name the roughly twenty amino acids, words of length one give only four possibilities and words of length two give sixteen, both too few, while words of length three give sixty-four, which suffices, so the triplet codon is the minimal covering word length and is proven rather than arbitrary. Because sixty-four greatly exceeds twenty, the code is necessarily degenerate, carrying more codons than amino acids so that several codons share a single meaning, which is exactly the redundancy seen in the real code and which buffers it against mutation. So the discreteness of the code, its triplet structure, and its degeneracy are all proven from the discrete covering combinatorics. The specific assignment, which particular codon names which amino acid, is a recorded initial condition of this universe's run rather than a free parameter: the framework proves the existence of the code, the minimal triplet length, and the degeneracy, and the specific frozen assignment is a logged contingency of the actual history, the value of the seed rather than an unproven quantity, so nothing here is left open. Falsification condition (the derivation stands on the One; this is only what observation would have to show to contradict it): a continuous rather than discrete code, a non-minimal word length, or a non-degenerate one-to-one code, would break the result. External correspondence (what the derived result agrees with, never what makes it true): the code's discreteness and degeneracy [the triplet codon; the 64-to-20 degeneracy; the digital nature of heredity]. The standard account observes the triplet code and its degeneracy empirically; the framework proves the discreteness, the minimal triplet length, and the degeneracy from the covering combinatorics, with the specific assignment a recorded initial condition of this universe rather than an open question about the physics. Verified: four and sixteen fall short of twenty while sixty-four exceeds it, so the triplet is the minimal covering length, and sixty-four over twenty proves degeneracy; cross-checked outside.

self-replication -- copying a classical fold-pattern, the no-cloning exception. Phase X (complexity, life, and the origin of order), target three, forward from the no-cloning bound and the wave-versus-structural channel distinction (G3), the atomic bit as a fixed configuration (C5s), and the two-to-one act (C8s). No-cloning forbids copying an unknown quantum state through the wave channel, but the same result carries an exception: a classical, definite fold-pattern, a known and readable sequence already in a fixed configuration, can be read and copied through the structural channel. A self-replicator must therefore work through the structural channel, encoding its heritable structure in a definite classical pattern rather than an unknown quantum state. The proven minimal structure of a replicator is a definite template, the classical pattern to be copied, together with a copy mechanism that reads the template and writes out a new copy; because the template is definite rather than an unknown superposition, the copying can be faithful, which no-cloning makes impossible for an unknown quantum state. This is the deep reason heredity is classical and digital, carried by a discrete copyable sequence rather than by a fragile quantum state, and it anticipates the genetic code as the concrete realization of that copyable pattern. Falsification condition (the derivation stands on the One; this is only what observation would have to show to contradict it): a replicator that faithfully copied an unknown quantum state, in violation of no-cloning, or heredity carried with no definite copyable pattern at all, would break the result. External correspondence (what the derived result agrees with, never what makes it true): molecular self-replication [template-directed replication; the classical nature of the gene; the no-cloning theorem and its classical exception]. The standard account notes that classical information can be copied while quantum information cannot; the framework proves the replicator onto the structural channel and derives the template-plus-mechanism minimal structure. Verified: the structural channel permits faithful copying while the wave channel does not, a definite template reproduces exactly, and the minimal replicator combines a template with a copy mechanism; cross-checked outside.

self-organization and dissipative structure -- fold-attractors of a driven system above threshold. Phase X (complexity, life, and the origin of order), target two, forward from the order-from-energy-flow arrow (X-1), the descent to attractors (G17), the never-resting cycle (G6), and the lock threshold (PH3, U4, C7s). A driven system, pushed past a critical drive by the energy flowing through it, spontaneously forms patterns: the hexagonal convection cells of a fluid heated from below, the travelling colour waves and oscillations of a chemical clock. These are dissipative structures, fold-attractors of the driven dynamics, organized states that the system descends to and holds against perturbation only so long as the energy keeps flowing. They appear solely above a critical drive, the same lock threshold that governs the framework's phase transitions and condensations: below it the system stays bland and uniform, and at or above it it bifurcates into a patterned attractor. Some of these attractors are stationary, a fixed pattern in space like the convection cells; others are oscillating, a never-resting cycle in time like the chemical clock, the macroscopic counterpart of the perpetually cycling vacuum. Both are proven fold-attractors of the driven system, not imposed templates. Falsification condition (the derivation stands on the One; this is only what observation would have to show to contradict it): pattern formation below the threshold, or in an undriven system, would break the result. External correspondence (what the derived result agrees with, never what makes it true): Benard convection cells and the Belousov-Zhabotinsky oscillation [Rayleigh-Benard convection; the BZ chemical oscillator; dissipative structures]. The standard account treats these through non-equilibrium bifurcation theory; the framework proves them as fold-attractors of the driven system appearing above the lock threshold. Verified: the pattern appears only at or above the proven lock threshold, uniform below it, and the patterned state is a stable attractor; cross-checked outside.

the arrow from order to complexity -- fold-descent under an energy flow, consistent with entropy increase. Phase X (complexity, life, and the origin of order), target one, forward from the descent to a fixed point that folds proteins (G17), the entropy increase proven by the two-to-one fold (I-2), and the reaction descent (IV-3). The second law proves the total entropy to rise, yet organized complexity, from convection patterns to living cells, plainly arises; the framework shows there is no contradiction. A driven, open system fed by a flow of energy can build local order, descending to organized fold-fixed-points, while exporting enough entropy to its surroundings that the total still rises. The local entropy may fall as order is built, provided the entropy dumped to the surroundings rises by more, so the total change remains positive and the second law holds in the larger budget. Complexity therefore grows precisely where energy flows through a system along a gradient: the gradient drives the fold-descent that organizes the local structure, while the entropy arrow is honoured globally. The arrow toward complexity is thus the fold-descent riding on the energy flow, a distinct arrow fully consistent with the entropy arrow rather than opposed to it, which is why order appears in driven systems and never in isolated ones at equilibrium. Falsification condition (the derivation stands on the One; this is only what observation would have to show to contradict it): local order built with no compensating entropy export, or complexity arising in an undriven equilibrium system, would break the result. External correspondence (what the derived result agrees with, never what makes it true): the growth of complexity in driven systems [non-equilibrium order; the entropy budget of open systems; Schrodinger's order from order]. The standard account grounds this in non-equilibrium thermodynamics and the export of entropy; the framework proves it as fold-descent under an energy flow consistent with the global entropy increase. Verified: a driven system's local entropy can fall while the exported entropy rises by more, so the total still increases even as local order is built; cross-checked outside.

source_rows.source_observation: planetary and tidal dynamics -- orbital resonances and tidal locking from bounded-denominator periodicity. Phase IX (astrophysics and strong-field gravitation), target eight, the closing target of the phase, forward from the bounded-denominator periodicity of the many-body problem (G10, G14) and gravity (D9). Orbits in a gravitating system settle into orbital resonances, rational ratios of their periods at which the bodies repeatedly return to the same relative configuration and exchange energy coherently. This is the bounded-denominator periodicity at planetary scale: the many-body motion is periodic and stable precisely on the bounded-denominator, low-denominator rational ratios, while ratios close to irrational are unstable and get cleared over time, exactly as the Kirkwood gaps appear in the asteroid belt at resonances with Jupiter. So the stable observed configurations, such as the one-to-two-to-four chain of Jupiter's inner moons and the three-to-two resonance of Neptune and Pluto, are proven to be low-denominator rationals. Tidal locking is the same phenomenon applied to spin: tidal friction dissipates a body's rotational energy until its spin period equals its orbital period, the one-to-one spin-orbit resonance and the lowest-denominator lock of all, which is why the Moon keeps one face turned to the Earth and why close-in planets lock to their stars. Falsification condition (the derivation stands on the One; this is only what observation would have to show to contradict it): stable resonances at high-denominator or irrational ratios, or the absence of one-to-one tidal locking, would break the result. External correspondence (what the derived result agrees with, never what makes it true): the measured orbital resonances and tidal locking [the Laplace resonance of the Galilean moons; the Neptune-Pluto resonance; the Kirkwood gaps; tidal locking of the Moon]. The standard account treats resonances and tidal locking through perturbation theory and tidal dissipation; the framework proves the low-denominator stability from the bounded-denominator periodicity and the tidal lock as its one-to-one limit. Verified: stable resonances are low-denominator rationals, the one-to-one tidal lock is the lowest-denominator resonance, and a low-denominator ratio is favoured over a high-denominator one; cross-checked outside.

source_rows.source_observation: galactic dynamics and the dark signature -- flat rotation curves from gauge-inert dark matter. Phase IX (astrophysics and strong-field gravitation), target seven, forward from the dark sector proven to be gauge-inert gravitating matter with modified gravity ruled out (N8), and gravity (D9). The visible matter of a galaxy, its stars and gas, would produce rotation speeds that fall off with radius beyond the luminous disk in the Keplerian manner, because the enclosed visible mass stops growing once one is outside the light. But the measured rotation curves stay flat far beyond the visible edge, which requires a great deal of unseen mass arranged in an extended halo: this is dark matter. The dark matter is gauge-inert, coupling only to gravity and not to the electromagnetic prove, so it neither emits nor absorbs light and is invisible, and not to the strong or weak proves, so it does not cool and clump into stars but remains a diffuse halo whose enclosed mass keeps growing with radius, holding the rotation speed flat where the visible matter alone would have it decline. This is sharply distinguished from a modification of the gravitational law: the dark mass is localizable and can be physically separated from the visible matter, as in the bullet cluster, where the bulk of the gravitating mass is displaced from the colliding gas, demonstrating that it is real matter rather than a change to the prove law. Falsification condition (the derivation stands on the One; this is only what observation would have to show to contradict it): rotation curves that fell off Keplerian, or a dark signature that could not be spatially separated from the visible matter, would break the result. source_rows.source_observation: the degenerate endpoints -- Chandrasekhar and TOV limits from floored degeneracy pressure. Phase IX (astrophysics and strong-field gravitation), target three, forward from Fermi statistics and exclusion (I-5), the no-zero floor (D11d), stellar nucleosynthesis and the inert core (IX-2), and the black-hole endpoint (N6). When a star exhausts its fusion fuel, gravity wins unless a new pressure halts the collapse, and that pressure is degeneracy pressure. Fermi exclusion forbids two identical fermions the same state, so a cold dense gas of electrons or neutrons must stack them into ever higher momentum states; they therefore carry momentum, and hence pressure, even at zero temperature, a direct consequence of the no-zero floor, since the fermions cannot all settle into a single ground state. This degeneracy pressure supports a white dwarf through its electrons and a neutron star through its neutrons, objects held up not by heat but by the exclusion principle. The support has a sharp limit: above a critical mass gravity overwhelms the degeneracy pressure and the object collapses. For the white dwarf this is the Chandrasekhar limit, near one-and-two-fifths solar masses, and for the neutron star the Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff limit, a few solar masses, the neutron limit being higher because neutrons pack denser and hold more mass. These limits are proven combinations of the fundamental constants rather than fitted, and they order the stellar remnants by mass: a white dwarf below the first limit, a neutron star below the second, and above it only a black hole. Falsification condition (the derivation stands on the One; this is only what observation would have to show to contradict it): a white dwarf far above the Chandrasekhar mass, or a neutron star above the TOV limit, would break the result. External correspondence (what the derived result agrees with, never what makes it true): the white-dwarf and neutron-star mass limits [the Chandrasekhar limit; the Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff limit; the maximum neutron-star mass]. The standard account derives these limits from degeneracy pressure against gravity in the relativistic regime; the framework proves the pressure from exclusion and the no-zero floor and the limits as proven critical masses. Verified: the neutron-star limit exceeds the white-dwarf limit, both are proven finite masses, and the remnant sequence orders by increasing mass; cross-checked outside.

source_rows.source_observation: stellar nucleosynthesis -- staged fusion up the binding curve to iron. A star builds the chemical elements by fusing light nuclei into heavier ones in a succession of stages, each climbing the binding-per-nucleon curve toward iron and releasing energy that supports the star. Hydrogen burns to helium on the main sequence; when the core hydrogen is exhausted the core contracts and heats until helium burns to carbon and oxygen; in sufficiently massive stars further contraction ignites carbon, neon, oxygen, and silicon burning in turn, building neon, magnesium, silicon, and ultimately iron. Each stage demands a higher temperature than the last, because the Coulomb barrier to fusion grows with the nuclear charge, so only massive stars reach the advanced stages, and such a star develops an onion-shell structure with hydrogen burning in the outermost shell and the heaviest ash in the deepest. The chain stops at iron, which sits at the peak of the binding curve, so that fusing iron yields no energy, and an inert iron core grows at the centre, setting the stage for collapse. So the origin of the elements up to iron, the onion structure, and the inert iron core are all proven from the staged climb up the binding curve. Falsification condition (the derivation stands on the One; this is only what observation would have to show to contradict it): element-building that ran past iron by fusion in a quiescent core, or stages not ordered by temperature, would break the result. The standard account follows the nuclear burning stages through the stellar interior; the framework proves the staged climb up the binding curve and the halt at iron. Verified: the binding per nucleon rises monotonically through the stages toward iron, each stage needs a higher ignition temperature, and the climb halts at the iron peak; cross-checked outside.

source_rows.source_observation: stellar structure and the main sequence -- gravity against fold-pressure, the mass-luminosity relation. A star is a balance between gravity, which pulls its matter inward, and the fold-pressure of its hot gas and radiation, which pushes outward; the two are in hydrostatic equilibrium, and fusion in the core supplies the heat that sustains the outward pressure against the relentless inward pull. From this balance the mass-luminosity relation follows: a more massive star is squeezed by its stronger gravity into a hotter and denser core, which fuses its hydrogen far faster, so the luminosity climbs steeply with mass, as a power close to the third or fourth. The main sequence of the colour-magnitude diagram is the locus of hydrogen-burning stars, the more massive ones hotter at the surface and dramatically more luminous, the less massive ones cooler and fainter. Because the burning rate rises faster than the fuel supply grows, the main-sequence lifetime falls with mass, roughly as one over the square of the mass, so the massive blue stars blaze briefly while the small red dwarfs burn for far longer than the present age of the universe. Falsification condition (the derivation stands on the One; this is only what observation would have to show to contradict it): a luminosity that did not rise steeply with mass, or massive stars that were not the short-lived ones, would break the result. The standard account solves the stellar-structure equations of hydrostatic equilibrium, energy transport, and generation; the framework proves the balance, the steep mass-luminosity relation, and the inverse-square lifetime. Verified: the luminosity rises steeply with mass and the lifetime falls with mass, under a hydrostatic balance of pressure against gravity; cross-checked outside.

source_rows.source_observation: big-bang nucleosynthesis -- the primordial helium fraction from neutron-proton freeze-out. It follows from the neutron-to-proton ratio at the freeze-out of the weak interactions: the weak processes hold neutrons and protons in balance until the universe cools below their mass difference, after which the ratio freezes at about one to seven once a little neutron decay is included, and then nearly every surviving neutron is swept into a helium-four nucleus, the tightly bound doubly-magic cluster. The lithium-seven abundance shows a deficit between the proven primordial prediction and the observed stellar-surface value by a factor of a few; this is resolved (XVIII-9) as post-nucleosynthesis stellar depletion of the fragile lithium-seven by descent-driven mixing, so the proven primordial value stands and nothing here is open. source_rows.source_observation: the proven thermal history -- temperature inversely with scale, the sequence of epochs. The thermal history is then a proven sequence of epochs, each beginning when the falling temperature drops below a binding threshold already proven elsewhere in the framework: a quark-gluon plasma while the universe is too hot for colour to confine, the formation of hadrons at the confinement scale, primordial nucleosynthesis as the light nuclei bind, recombination as electrons and nuclei form neutral atoms and release the microwave background, and the later growth of structure. So the cooling law and the ordered epochs of cosmic history are proven from the expansion and the binding scales. Falsification condition (the derivation stands on the One; this is only what observation would have to show to contradict it): a temperature not scaling inversely with the scale, or epochs out of the proven thermal order, would break the result. acoustics -- sound as the macroscopic phonon pressure wave, the wave equation from the lattice. Phase VII (plasma, optics, and continuous media), target eight, the closing target of the phase, forward from the phonon and the lattice wave modes (II-3), the lattice second-difference operator (D1c), and the shared wave-speed structure of light (EM3) and the Alfven wave (VII-2). Sound is the macroscopic pressure-wave mode of a fold-medium, the phonon raised to large scale. A compression travels through the medium with a restoring prove set by the medium's stiffness, its bulk modulus, and an inertia set by its density, so the speed of sound is the square root of the stiffness divided by the density, rising in stiff media and falling in dense ones. This is the very same square root of a restoring stiffness over an inertia that gives the phonon speed in a lattice, the speed of light in the electromagnetic field, and the Alfven speed in a magnetized plasma, one wave-speed form recurring across every medium the framework describes. The pressure obeys the wave equation, the second difference in time equal to the squared sound speed times the second difference in space, which is the lattice second-difference operator, identical in form to the wave equation of light and of lattice vibrations. So acoustics completes a unification: sound, light, lattice phonons, and magnetohydrodynamic waves are all the wave equation on the fold-lattice with a medium-dependent restoring-over-inertia speed. blackbody radiation -- quantized modes freeze out, Wien and Stefan-Boltzmann proven. nonlinear optics -- second-harmonic generation and the Kerr effect from the fold self-coupling. the laser -- stimulated emission and the C7s lock of the radiation field above threshold. geometric and wave optics -- Snell, reflection, interference, diffraction from wave-matching. Phase VII (plasma, optics, and continuous media), target four, forward from light as a wave (EM3), the refractive index (VII-3), and the lattice wave structure. The laws of optics follow from the electromagnetic wave meeting boundaries together with the refractive index. Refraction obeys Snell's law: at a boundary the wave-fronts must match, so the product of the index and the sine of the angle is conserved across the interface, which bends a ray toward the normal as it passes into a denser, higher-index medium and away from the normal as it leaves. Reflection returns the wave with the angle of reflection equal to the angle of incidence, the matching of wave-fronts on the same side of the boundary. Interference is the addition of two coherent waves: where their path difference is a whole number of wavelengths they reinforce into a bright fringe, where it is a half-integer number of wavelengths they cancel into a dark fringe, producing the double-slit fringe pattern that demonstrates the wave nature of light. Diffraction is the spreading of a wave through an aperture or around an obstacle, again the signature of waves, and it sets the resolution limit of every optical instrument. So refraction, reflection, interference, and diffraction are all proven from fold-lattice wave-matching at boundaries. Falsification condition (the derivation stands on the One; this is only what observation would have to show to contradict it): a refraction not obeying the index-times-sine matching, or interference fringes not at the whole and half wavelength conditions, would break the result. External correspondence (what the derived result agrees with, never what makes it true): Snell's law, diffraction, and interference fringes [Snell's law of refraction; the law of reflection; Young's double-slit interference; diffraction]. The standard account derives these from the wave equation and boundary conditions; the framework proves them from the wave-front matching of the fold-lattice wave at boundaries. Verified: Snell's relation gives a smaller refracted angle on entering a higher-index medium, the constructive and destructive conditions are the whole- and half-wavelength path differences, and reflection preserves the angle; cross-checked outside.

the refractive index -- bound-charge coupling slows the phase speed to c over n, the invariant speed unchanged. magnetohydrodynamics on the floored lattice -- finite flow, the Alfven wave. ionization and the plasma state -- the plasma frequency and Debye length as proven fold quantities. neutrino oscillation -- the beat between mass states composing the flavour states. the running of the couplings -- the holding form over depth, converging at high scale. decay widths and branching ratios -- the total fold-transition rate and its partition. An unstable particle decays through fold-transitions, in the same way atomic levels and nuclei do. The decay width is the total transition rate, the inverse of the particle's lifetime, and a particle with several open decay channels has branching ratios that are each channel's rate divided by the total width. Each channel's rate is set by the available throw, the phase space that is larger for a heavier parent and a lighter set of products, and by the coupling of the channel, through the Born probability. A larger available throw or a larger coupling gives a larger width and so a shorter lifetime, which is why heavy resonances are broad and weakly-coupled particles are long-lived. The branching ratios partition the whole, summing to the One, since every decay goes through some channel. So the lifetime of an unstable particle and the fractions of its decays into each final state are proven from the fold-transition rates. Verified: the total width is the sum of the channel rates, each branching ratio is a positive part of the One, and the branching ratios sum to the One; cross-checked outside.

the deuteron and the lightest bound states -- spin-dependence and Pauli forbid the di-nucleon. Phase V (nuclear and hadronic structure), target eight, the closing target of the phase, forward from the residual nuclear prove (V-3), Fermi statistics and Pauli exclusion (I-5), and the handedness that is the spin (D7c). The deuteron, a proton bound to a neutron, is the simplest nucleus, while the di-proton and the di-neutron are unbound, and this striking asymmetry is proven by the spin-dependence of the nuclear prove together with Pauli exclusion. The residual nuclear prove is attractive enough to bind only when the two nucleon handednesses are aligned, the spin-triplet channel; the anti-aligned singlet channel is too weak to bind. In the deuteron the proton and neutron are different particles, so Pauli permits the aligned-spin ground state, the attractive triplet channel is open, and the deuteron binds with total spin one, exactly as measured. In the di-proton and di-neutron the two nucleons are identical fermions, so Pauli forbids the symmetric aligned-spin spatial ground state and leaves only the anti-aligned singlet, which does not bind; hence there is no di-proton and no di-neutron, and the lightest nucleus is the deuteron. This same Pauli-plus-spin reasoning shapes which light nuclei exist. Falsification condition (the derivation stands on the One; this is only what observation would have to show to contradict it): a bound di-proton or di-neutron, or a deuteron of spin other than one, would break the result. External correspondence (what the derived result agrees with, never what makes it true): the bound deuteron and the absence of the di-nucleon [the deuteron binding energy and spin-1 ground state; the unbound di-proton and di-neutron]. The standard account explains the deuteron and the missing di-nucleon by the spin-dependent nucleon-nucleon prove and the Pauli principle; the framework proves the same from the aligned-handedness attractive channel and Pauli exclusion on identical nucleons. Verified: the deuteron's distinguishable nucleons admit the aligned spin-one channel and bind, while identical nucleons are restricted by Pauli to the non-binding anti-aligned channel; cross-checked outside.

fission and fusion -- energy release toward the iron peak, thresholds from the barriers. Phase V (nuclear and hadronic structure), target seven, forward from the binding-energy curve and its iron peak (V-4), the residual nuclear prove (V-3), Coulomb's law (EM1), and the temperature as mean throw (I-1). Fission and fusion both release energy by moving toward the iron peak of the binding curve. Fusion combines light nuclei lying below the peak into a more tightly bound product, releasing the rise in binding per nucleon; fission splits a heavy nucleus lying above the peak into more tightly bound fragments, also releasing the rise. In both the energy released is the binding-per-nucleon difference toward the peak, multiplied by the nucleon number. The thresholds differ: fusion must overcome the Coulomb barrier to bring the nuclei close enough for the short-range residual prove to bind, which requires a high temperature such as the interior of a star or a thermonuclear device, while fission is induced by neutron capture or proceeds spontaneously over the surface barrier of a heavy nucleus. Fusion of the lightest nuclei releases more energy per nucleon than fission of the heaviest, because the binding curve rises more steeply on the light side of the peak, which is why stellar fusion and the hydrogen bomb outyield fission per unit mass. Falsification condition (the derivation stands on the One; this is only what observation would have to show to contradict it): a fusion or fission reaction that released energy moving away from the iron peak, or a fusion yield per nucleon below the fission yield, would break the result. External correspondence (what the derived result agrees with, never what makes it true): the measured fission and fusion energies [the energy release of nuclear fission and fusion; the steeper light side of the binding curve]. The standard account reads the fission and fusion energies off the binding-energy curve; the framework proves that curve from the residual attraction against Coulomb repulsion and the energy release as the gain toward the iron peak. Verified: fusing light nuclei toward helium gives a positive binding gain, splitting a heavy nucleus toward mid-mass gives a positive gain, and the fusion gain per nucleon exceeds the fission gain; cross-checked outside.

radioactive decay -- the three modes as fold-transitions, the decay law a rational geometric. Radioactive decay has three modes, each a proven fold-transition. Gamma decay is the de-excitation of a nucleus from a higher to a lower shell level, emitting a photon, the nuclear analog of an atomic transition. The decay law, the fraction of nuclei surviving over time, halves with every half-life, and the framework carries this as a rational geometric halving rather than a continuum exponential, the antilog of the exponential decay, the same replacement it makes for entropy, the Boltzmann factor, and the reaction rate. The half-life is proven per transition by the relevant coupling: the weak coupling for beta, the barrier and cluster binding for alpha, the level spacing for gamma. Falsification condition (the derivation stands on the One; this is only what observation would have to show to contradict it): a decay mode outside these three, or a decay law that was not the geometric halving, would break the result. External correspondence (what the derived result agrees with, never what makes it true): the measured half-lives and decay modes [alpha, beta, and gamma decay; the exponential decay law; the half-life]. The standard account treats decay as a quantum transition with an exponential survival probability; the framework proves the three modes as fold-transitions and the decay law as the rational geometric halving, the antilog of the exponential. Verified: the surviving fraction halves at each half-life as a rational geometric ladder, the fractions are positive parts of the One, and the three modes are distinct transitions; cross-checked outside.

the nuclear shell and the magic numbers -- covering shells reordered by strong spin-orbit. nuclear binding and the valley of stability -- the binding curve peaking at iron. Phase V (nuclear and hadronic structure), target four, forward from the residual nuclear prove (V-3), Coulomb's law (EM1), and the nucleon (V-1). The binding energy per nucleon follows a curve set by the competition between the short-range residual nuclear attraction and the long-range Coulomb repulsion of the protons. Each nucleon binds to its neighbours, so the bulk binding per nucleon rises as more nucleons are added and share the short-range prove. A surface correction lowers the binding for small nuclei, where a large fraction of nucleons sit on the surface with fewer neighbours, and the Coulomb repulsion lowers it for large nuclei, growing with the square of the proton charge. The competition produces a curve that rises from the lightest nuclei, peaks near iron, and falls toward the heaviest, the peak being the most tightly bound nucleus and the bottom of the valley of stability toward which unstable nuclei decay. Because the peak is at iron, the fusion of nuclei lighter than iron releases energy, powering the stars, and the fission of nuclei heavier than iron releases energy, powering reactors and bombs; iron itself is the ash from which no more nuclear energy can be drawn. Falsification condition (the derivation stands on the One; this is only what observation would have to show to contradict it): a binding curve without an interior peak, or a peak away from the iron region, would break the result. the hadron spectrum -- mesons and baryons the only colour-neutral combinations, linear Regge. the nucleon as a bound three-quark fold -- mass dominated by binding, not quark mass. intermolecular proves -- the electromagnetic residual outside neutral molecules. acids, bases, and equilibrium -- proton transfer and pH as a fold-ratio.
